Grand Hyatt Doha is seeking a dynamic and creative Marketing Executive to support the development and execution of marketing, branding, public relations, and digital marketing initiatives. The role is responsible for enhancing brand visibility, driving guest engagement, supporting revenue-generating activities, and ensuring consistent brand communication across all platforms in line with Hyatt standards.
q: Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Marketing, Communications, Business Administration, Hospitality Management, or a related field.
Minimum 1-2 years of experience in marketing, communications, digital marketing, hospitality, or a related industry.
Previous experience in a luxury hotel or hospitality environment is an advantage.
Strong understanding of social media platforms including Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, and YouTube.
Basic knowledge of digital marketing, content creation, and social media analytics.
Familiarity with graphic design tools such as Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, or similar platforms is preferred.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; additional languages are an advantage.
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.
Creative mindset with strong attention to detail.
Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced hospitality environment.
